news.paragraph: Silver prices are facing pressure due to weakening demand, according to recent analysis. While some silver stocks have seen significant year-to-date surges, the broader outlook for the precious metal is mixed, with conflicting reports on investment appeal and underlying demand trends. Investors are advised to consider the fee structure and tax implications associated with silver-backed ETFs like SLV.
